bills.title: Crimes and Other Legislation Amendment (Omnibus) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-09-04.67.1) introduced by NSW Senator [David Shoebridge](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/david_shoebridge) (Greens), which means they failed. ### What do these amendments do? Senator Shoebridge [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-09-04.67.1): > *These amendments taken together add in a number of matters that need to be considered by the Attorney-General in making a decision on transferring a prisoner to other countries. They include explicit consideration of matters including a prisoner's welfare, family and community support, medical conditions and disability, and the ability to receive appropriate care for these education, accommodation and employment services post-release.*
